warnings: Wallet, Gum Drops balance, purchase, and unlock flows are P0 launch risks.
Auth, onboarding, viewer access, and protected admin/payment routes are P0 launch risks.
Notifications, chat/messages, creator routing, Drops discovery/detail, 404 recovery, and mobile safe-area layout are P1 launch risks.
Admin overview, analytics, and Debug truth are P2 launch risks and must remain truth-preserving.
Recent hot-cache, parity, admin truth, notification, task, chat, and drop card migrations are stabilization zones.
deferred: New analytics modules or architecture expansion.
New creator tools, merchandising systems, profile experiments, or discovery mechanics.
AI generation feature expansion unless required for an existing launch blocker.
A/B tests, conversion experiments, and speculative personalization.
Broad visual redesigns, large component rewrites, and non-blocking performance experiments.
Telemetry schema expansion unless required for launch-critical admin truth.

frozenFeatureList: GumDrops economy mechanics and source-of-funds behavior
Unlock entitlement semantics and viewer access rules
Admin Analytics architecture beyond verified snapshot/hot-cache truth fixes
Admin Debug evidence model beyond truth-preserving launch fixes
Creator profile routing behavior except broken route recovery
Chat/message routing behavior except launch-blocking delivery or navigation defects
Notification pipeline behavior except duplicate, missing, or false-state launch defects
Drops merchandising, ranking, and discovery feature behavior beyond correctness fixes
AI/admin generation behavior except launch-blocking failures or unsafe output handling
allowedChangeTypes: Verified launch-blocker bug fixes on a launch-critical surface
Security, payment, auth, admin route protection, or entitlement fixes backed by failing checks or direct code evidence
Truth-preserving copy or diagnostic corrections that expose the real state more clearly
Narrow hydration, mobile safe-area, accessibility, or recovery-route fixes required for launch use
Targeted tests, validation scripts, docs, and checklist updates tied to launch gates
Fixes that preserve existing snapshots, hot-cache truth, Debug metadata, and validation output
forbiddenChangeTypes: New product features or feature expansion
Full-page redesigns or large visual overhauls
Architecture rewrites without verified launch-blocker evidence
Cosmetic copy that hides a failure, source delay, missing snapshot, or partial state
Removing validation, Debug truth, source labels, or audit evidence
Publicly caching private admin, payment, wallet, or user data
Fake zeros, fake pass states, fake live states, generic waiting, or silent fallbacks
Touching unrelated modules while fixing a launch surface
Changing wallet, PayPal, GumDrops, unlock, or entitlement semantics without explicit approval and proof
Deleting realtime listeners, legacy parity guards, or hot-cache fallbacks because they are inconvenient

riskRanking.meaning: Launch can be blocked, security can regress, money/entitlement can break, or protected data can be exposed.
Core user flow, navigation, communication, recovery, or mobile usability can break.
Launch operation and confidence can degrade, but customer launch paths are usually not directly blocked.
Deferred unless directly tied to a verified launch blocker.

scopeFreezeRules: Start from launch-critical surfaces and prove the blocker before editing.
Use verified runtime code, configuration, and command output over generated docs.
Age, delay, partial state, or source caveats must be labeled truthfully instead of hidden.
Do not make stale or estimated data look live.
Do not remove validation or Debug evidence during launch hardening.
Run targeted gates first and reserve broad slow audits for signoff or blocker proof.
